media.title: MGM Years — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper's MGM/Hollywood years. Includes Polish and American press coverage, studio-era publicity, reviews, and contextual images from 1934–1938. SRC0041 is represented here as a Nasz Przegląd Ilustrowany 1934 clipped press image showing Kaper, not as a separate standalone Media record within this gallery.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s MGM years, combining documents, press items and contextual images.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of documents, press items and contextual images relating to Bronisław Kaper’s early MGM years and Hollywood career in the mid-1930s.

media.title: Bronisław Kaper — portrait crop from Nasz Przegląd Ilustrowany, 1934
media.description: Standalone media record for the cropped photograph of Bronisław Kaper from Nasz Przegląd Ilustrowany, R. 12, nr 43, Polona date 28 October 1934. This image is also represented in the MGM Years gallery M034, but is kept separately here because it functions as an individual iconographic object.
